name: Kagura Rio
source: The chairman of the board who presides over the town filled with the most extraordinary schoolgirls. She is the elite CEO of a large financial conglomerate and has succeeded many financial achievements. She despises incompetent men and aim to create a woman-centered society through artificial insemination. A serious educator. She uses the superior Western genes to create the best young ladies. She tries to banish the virile protagonist but...
